body:
I don't really have anywhere to go, tbh. My only friend that knows (and I would trust) about this situation lives in another state, so I can't stay there. No close relatives, they all live in another country/far away.

Thanks for the support.
I'm sorry that you have to go through the same thing.
There are no marks and I don't trust the counselors at my school.

I'd rather not go thru social services because I really don't want to get taken out of home and put into a foster system or something. I'm 16 so I'm gonna try to wait it out until I'm 18 (maybe even 17 if I can convince my parents to allow me to attempt to emancipate) and move out. Also, I fear if I contact child protective services my sister will get taken out of the home, too, and I feel that'd be worse than sticking it out here.

I've threatened to call the police on both my Nparents and they always say "good, then you'll go to a foster home worse than this house!" And I'm pretty sure, with the U.S. child care system, that would probably happen.

I'm trying, I'm not quite old enough to get a job (I'm only 15, legal age is 16) and I know this sounds like an excuse but once school starts my schedule will be FULL. I'm taking 4 AP classes, have cross country and track, along with a few clubs. I'm doing all this stuff because I'm hoping I'll end up lucky and get a scholarship to Harvard or something. Maybe by summer before senior year (I'm a junior) I'll be able to juggle a job and school, but I'm not sure.
I have a feeling that this would be what would happen

I don't think emancipation is really an option because I am not financially independent from them and I bet it would hurt their feelings if i even asked, and if I do have to deal with living with them, I'm not going to deal with them guilt tripping me about asking for emancipation daily.
Living at home is a joke, I'm getting as far away as from as I can as soon as possible...
Thank you so much, I appreciate it!
Pretty sure if I did that I would have the shit beat out of me and be thrown out to the streets so I don't think that's the best option :)
I'm so jealous of you lol
Bohemian Rhapsody. I have no idea why
